layer.name: VK_LAYER_LGL_neural_statistics
layer.description: Structured capture layer for neural accelerator statistics

settings.label: Capture Folder
settings.description: Exact root folder for this capture. Existing roots are rejected. If the setting is absent at runtime, the layer generates a timestamped root.

settings.label: Statistics Mode
settings.description: Select exactly one VkNeuralAcceleratorStatisticsModeARM for the capture.

settings.label: Dispatch Filter
settings.description: Blank captures all executed dispatches. N selects one zero-based occurrence; N-M selects an inclusive zero-based range. Only surrounding whitespace is accepted.
